title: Too early for victory formation?
summary: Trevor Lawrence stopped near the goal line with more than eight minutes left. New England used a timeout, and Bhayshul Tuten scored on the next play in Jacksonville’s 35–6 win.

timeline.label: Third-and-4
timeline.text: Lawrence scrambled from the New England 16.

timeline.label: Near the goal line
timeline.text: He deliberately went down instead of finishing the run in the end zone.

timeline.label: Next play
timeline.text: After a Patriots timeout, Tuten ran for the touchdown.

unusual: Giving up a score can protect a lead late in a game, but this happened well before the final minutes.
explanations: Lawrence explained that he was trying to consume time and acknowledged the timing was unnecessary. That is a football explanation; it does not establish any betting motive.
